findings.title: Student email and phone digits written to application logs in plaintext
findings.risk_to_rights: Log files with direct identifiers can be exposed via server compromise, log aggregation leakage, or overly broad ops access; subjects cannot know or contest this secondary processing
findings.evidence: Payment.php:1651 Log::info("Попытка отправки письма. Студент: {$student->email}..."); User.php:830 Log::info("Пропуск SMS: У пользователя {$this->email}..."); SmsRuChannel.php:47 Log::error('SMS.ru send failed', ['phone' => $digits, 'response' => $body])
findings.recommended_fix: Replace direct identifiers with user_id (or hash) in log lines; mask phone to last 2 digits; add a structured-logging redaction helper and sweep Log:: call sites
findings.verification_needed: grep sweep after fix shows no raw email/phone in Log:: context; sample log line

findings.title: No data-subject erasure or access/export workflow exists
findings.risk_to_rights: A student requesting deletion or a copy of their data has no supported path; requests would have to be fulfilled manually from the DB, risking missed data in backups, chats, exports
findings.location: (absence) — app/Console/Commands has no user delete/erase/export command; no DSAR controller
findings.evidence: Command census 2026-09-18: only DeleteCatalogShells / SyncPedagogyExportFromSg match delete|export; no user-facing erasure or portability mechanism
findings.recommended_fix: Add an artisan command + admin action: anonymize/delete a user across users, payments (retention-constrained), telegram_support chats, leads; plus a data-export command emitting JSON/CSV of held personal data
findings.verification_needed: command exists, tested against a seeded user fixture, payments retained per finance-law constraint documented

findings.title: Student/VK chat content sent to DeepSeek via OpenRouter (US) without documented transfer mechanism
findings.risk_to_rights: Support message content (often containing identity, schedule, payment context) processed by a third-country AI provider under no documented DPA/TIA
findings.evidence: ProcessVkBotMessage.php:267 'Думает единый сервис (DeepSeek через OpenRouter)'; CuratorAi.php carries an explicit privacy guard: never fall back to OpenRouter (privacy-driven routing)
findings.recommended_fix: Document DPA/TIA for OpenRouter (or route only through the direct provider where the privacy guard already restricts it); strip user identifiers from prompt context; extend the no-OpenRouter guard to all AI call sites
findings.verification_needed: DPA artifact or provider-region contract terms on file; call-site census of OpenRouter usage

findings.title: PayPal processing of payer data without documented DPA/SCC artifact
findings.risk_to_rights: Cross-border transfer of payer identity/transaction data to a US processor without a visible transfer mechanism in provided materials
findings.location: config/services.php:570 (PAYPAL_ME_LINK); PayPal salary conversion + subscription flows
findings.evidence: config/services.php paypal.me integration; salary/PayPal conversion flows in app (AGENTS.md money contour)
findings.recommended_fix: Attach PayPal DPA acceptance + transfer mechanism note to the compliance file; verify no more payer data than needed is transmitted
findings.verification_needed: signed/accepted DPA record; field census of what is sent to PayPal APIs

findings.title: Backups replicated to Yandex Disk without transfer-mechanism documentation (encrypted, retention defined)
findings.risk_to_rights: Low given archive encryption and defined retention; residual risk is undocumented cross-border posture if EU-resident subjects exist
findings.evidence: destination disks local + split_upload disk yandex_disk; BACKUP_ARCHIVE_PASSWORD env + encryption default; keep_all 7d/daily 16d/weekly 8w/monthly 4m
findings.recommended_fix: Record the Yandex transfer posture in the compliance file; verify archive password strength/rotation

findings.title: Free-form users.notes carries legacy support personal data with no retention rule
findings.risk_to_rights: Indefinite retention of free-form notes (contact details, context from legacy support conversations) without purpose review
findings.location: users table (telegram fields migration 2026_03_14); telegram:backfill-usernames-from-notes command normalizes legacy notes
findings.evidence: AGENTS.md deployment note: run telegram:backfill-usernames-from-notes --apply only with user agreement to normalize legacy notes
findings.recommended_fix: After the backfill completes, truncate/migrate residual personal data out of notes; define a retention/review rule

summary.dpia_recommended: no — bounded code-only evidence: AI responder is support Q&A, not evaluation/scoring with legal effect; <2 EDPB criteria evidenced
